verses.ar:
صَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ سَلَامُ اللّٰهِ ۞ عَلٰى طٰهٰ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ
صَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ سَلَامُ اللّٰهِ ۞ عَلٰى يَس حَبِيبِ اللّٰهِ
verses.tr: Ṣalātullāh salāmullāh · ʿalā Ṭāhā Rasūlillāh · Ṣalātullāh salāmullāh · ʿalā Yāsīn Ḥabībillāh
verses.en: The blessings of Allah, the peace of Allah, upon Taha, the Messenger of Allah; the blessings of Allah, the peace of Allah, upon Yasin, the Beloved of Allah.

verses.ar:
تَوَسَّلْنَا بِبِسْمِ اللّٰهِ ۞ وَبِالْهَادِي رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ
وَكُلِّ مُجَاهِدٍ لِلّٰهِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Tawassalnā bi-bismillāh · wa bi-l-hādī Rasūlillāh · Wa kulli mujāhidin lillāh · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: We seek our means through the name of Allah, through the Guide, the Messenger of Allah, and through every striver in Allah's way — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي سَلِّمِ الْأُمَّةْ ۞ مِنَ الْآفَاتِ وَالنِّقْمَةْ
وَمِنْ هَمٍّ وَمِنْ غُمَّةْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī sallimi-l-ummah · mina-l-āfāti wa-n-niqmah · Wa min hammin wa min ghummah · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, keep the community safe from afflictions and retribution, and from worry and from grief — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي نَجِّنَا وَاكْشِفْ ۞ جَمِيعَ أَذِيَّةٍ وَاصْرِفْ
مَكَائِدَ الْعِدَا وَالْطُفْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī najjinā wa-kshif · jamīʿa adhiyyatin wa-ṣrif · Makā'ida-l-ʿidā wa-lṭuf · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, deliver us, lift away every harm, turn aside the schemes of enemies, and be gentle with us — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي نَفِّسِ الْكُرَبَا ۞ مِنَ الْعَاصِينَ وَالْعَطْبَا
وَكُلِّ بَلِيَّةٍ وَوَبَاءْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī naffisi-l-kurabā · mina-l-ʿāṣīna wa-l-ʿaṭbā · Wa kulli baliyyatin wa wabā' · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, relieve the distress of the sinful and the ruined, and remove every trial and epidemic — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
فَكَمْ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ حَصَلَتْ ۞ وَكَمْ مِنْ ذِلَّةٍ فَصَلَتْ
وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ وَصَلَتْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Fa-kam min raḥmatin ḥaṣalat · wa kam min dhillatin faṣalat · Wa kam min niʿmatin waṣalat · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: How many a mercy has come to pass, how many a humiliation has been removed, how many a blessing has arrived — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
وَكَمْ أَغْنَيْتَ ذَا الْفَقْرِ ۞ وَكَمْ أَوْلَيْتَ ذَا الْعُمْرِ
وَكَمْ عَافَيْتَ ذَا الْوِزْرِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Wa kam aghnayta dhā-l-faqri · wa kam awlayta dhā-l-ʿumri · Wa kam ʿāfayta dhā-l-wizri · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: How many a poor one You have enriched, how many an aged one You have cared for, how many a burdened one You have healed — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
لَقَدْ ضَاقَتْ عَلٰى الْقَلْبِ ۞ جَمِيعُ الْأَرْضِ مَعْ رَحْبِ
فَأَنْجِ مِنَ الْبَلَا الصَّعْبِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Laqad ḍāqat ʿalā-l-qalbi · jamīʿu-l-arḍi maʿ raḥbi · Fa-anji mina-l-balā-ṣ-ṣaʿbi · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: The whole earth, for all its breadth, has closed in upon the heart — so rescue us from the harsh ordeal, through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
أَتَيْنَا طَالِبِي الرِّفْقِ ۞ وَجُلِّ الْخَيْرِ وَالسَّعْدِ
فَوَسِّعْ مِنْحَةَ الْأَيْدِي ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ataynā ṭālibī-r-rifqi · wa julli-l-khayri wa-s-saʿdi · Fa-wassiʿ minḥata-l-aydī · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: We have come seeking gentleness, abundant goodness and felicity — so widen the gift of Your hands, through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
فَلَا تَرْدُدْ مَعَ الْخَيْبَةْ ۞ بَلِ اجْعَلْنَا عَلٰى الطَّيْبَةْ
أَيَا ذَا الْعِزِّ وَالْهَيْبَةْ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Fa-lā tardud maʿa-l-khaybah · bali-jʿalnā ʿalā-ṭ-ṭaybah · Ayā dhā-l-ʿizzi wa-l-haybah · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: Do not turn us back in disappointment, but set us upon goodness, O Possessor of might and awe — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
وَإِنْ تَرْدُدْ فَمَنْ نَأْتِي ۞ بِنَيْلِ جَمِيعِ حَاجَاتِي
أَيَا جَالِي الْمُلِمَّاتِ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Wa in tardud fa-man na'tī · bi-nayli jamīʿi ḥājātī · Ayā jālī-l-mulimmāti · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: And if You turn us away, to whom would we go for the fulfilling of all my needs? O Remover of calamities — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي اغْفِرْ وَأَكْرِمْنَا ۞ بِنَيْلِ مَطَالِبٍ مِنَّا
وَدَفْعِ مَسَاءَةٍ عَنَّا ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī-ghfir wa akrimnā · bi-nayli maṭālibin minnā · Wa dafʿi masā'atin ʿannā · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, forgive us and honor us by granting our requests and warding harm away from us — through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
إِلَهِي أَنْتَ ذُو لُطْفٍ ۞ وَذُو فَضْلٍ وَذُو عَطْفٍ
وَكَمْ مِنْ كُرْبَةٍ تَنْفِي ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Ilāhī anta dhū luṭfin · wa dhū faḍlin wa dhū ʿaṭfin · Wa kam min kurbatin tanfī · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: My God, You are full of gentleness, of grace, of compassion — how many a hardship You dispel, through the people of Badr, O Allah.

verses.ar:
وَصَلِّ عَلٰى النَّبِي الْبَرِّ ۞ بِلَا عَدٍّ وَلَا حَصْرِ
وَآلٍ سَادَةٍ غُرِّ ۞ بِأَهْلِ الْبَدْرِ يَا اَللّٰهُ
verses.tr: Wa ṣalli ʿalā-n-nabī-l-barri · bilā ʿaddin wa lā ḥaṣri · Wa ālin sādatin ghurri · bi-ahli-l-Badri yā Allāh
verses.en: And send blessings upon the righteous Prophet, beyond all count and limit, and upon his family, the radiant masters — through the people of Badr, O Allah.
